visualBrief: Abomey’s historic royal museum courts, red earthen reception halls, shaded verandas, polychrome reliefs and surviving circular shelters.
limitations: Exterior reconstruction of the mapped Ghézo and Glélé museum precinct and selected surviving northern shelters and halls. Secondary building names, wall segments and gallery details are interpreted from the footprint patterns and photographs.
The palace grounds are much larger than this model. Unmodeled compounds, Akaba’s separate precinct, native roads and historic grounds stay in the map.
Bas-reliefs are original interpretations of the recurring motifs and color groupings, based on reference photographs. The site has no navigable museum interiors.

photoFacing.frontBasis: The named royal-palace POI and the PMTiles palace buildings and pedestrian approaches locate the model. The reception and entrance façades face the sampled court approaches.

terrain: Bilinear six-meter sampling from standard zoom-15 Terrarium tiles.
